st: Stephen King, Amy Brenneman, Ben Schwartz, TikTok Food Trends with Michelle Park
d: “Later” author Stephen King stops by to chat. “Tell Me Your Secrets” star Amy Brenneman joins Drew. “Flora & Ulysses” star Ben Schwartz joins Drew and Ross in Drew’s News. Plus, Drew tries the latest food trends on TikTok with chef Michelle Park.

st: Terry & Rebecca Crews, Cookbook Club with Kwame, Romance Refresh with The Young Emperors
d: ”America’s Got Talent's” Terry Crews and his wife Rebecca chat. Drew is joined by students who launched a zine which celebrates chefs of color. Kwame Onwuachi makes Jollof Rice with Jerk Rack of Lamb. Young Emperors give a married couple a fashion update.

st: Nikki Glaser, Retro Cooking, Shirley Temples With 7-Year-Old Shirley Temple King
d: Comedian Nikki Glaser and her mom Julie Glaser stop by to chat. Then, in Retro Cooking, Drew brings the 1950s tuna noodle casserole back to life. Seven-year-old Leo Kelly, aka The Shirley Temple King, stops by to whip up some Shirley Temples with Drew.

st: Neil Patrick Harris, Baking with Duff Goldman, Actress Michaela Watkins, Astrologer Aliza Kelly
d: Neil Patrick Harris on the inspiration behind Box One, an ever-evolving game that he co-created. Pastry chef Duff Goldman whips up chocolate peppermint cupcakes. "The Unicorn" star Michaela Watkins chats. Plus, celebrity astrologer Aliza Kelly.

st: Small Business Challenge, Edgar Ramirez, Wildflower Chef, Cleo Wade
d: Drew is joined by Kendra Scott for her first Small Business Challenge. Edgar Ramirez chats. Drew spotlights Chopped Champion Chef Roshara Sanders who teaches Drew how to make a jerk crab cake sandwich. Cleo Wade chats about her first children’s book.

st: Exclusive: Dylan Farrow, Katherine Schwarzenegger Pratt, Cooking with Pilar and Sahra Nguyen
d: Drew sits down for an exclusive conversation with Dylan Farrow on her HBO Max docuseries “Allen vs. Farrow.”  Katherine Schwarzenegger Pratt chats. Chef Pilar Valdes and founder of Nguyen Coffee Supply Sahra Nguyen share ways to use coffee in the kitchen.

st: Kevin Bacon, Cooking with Action Bronson, My Fairy Godfathers
d: Kevin Bacon joins Drew. Rapper and chef Action Bronson discusses his weight loss and whips up Backyard Markham Street Style Lamb Burgers. Meet the founders of My Fairy Godfathers, a non-profit dedicated to helping women in need by providing makeovers.

st: Beauty Week: Part Deux Kick-Off with Lena Dunham, Meredith Koop Makeover, Sharon Chuter
d: Drew kicks-off Beauty Week: Part Deux. Lena Dunham joins Drew. Michele Obama’s stylist Meredith Koop gives a makeover for a mom in need of a date night refresh. Makeup artist and founder of Uoma Beauty Sharon Chuter co-pilots a beauty-themed Drew’s News.

st: Anthony Anderson, Soleil Moon Frye, Drew’s News
d: “To Tell The Truth” hosts Anthony Anderson and his mom Doris Bowman chat. Soleil Moon Frye discuss her new doc “Kid 90,” an intimate look at young Hollywood starlets in the '90s. Drew and Ross Mathews serve the news sunny-side up in Drew's News.

st: Drew’s Halloween Show! "Emily in Paris" Star Ashley Park
d: Drew’s Halloween show! "Emily in Paris's" Ashley Park stops by. Plus, celebrations expert Darcy Miller shares tips to repurpose leftover Halloween candy. Drew's "Stans for Stains: Halloween Edition." A curated list of Drew's favorites in "The Weekender."

st: Lilly Singh, Butcher Loreal Gavin, Sean Evans
d: “A Little Late with Lilly Singh” host Lilly Singh stops by to chat. “Hot Ones” host Sean Evans joins Drew and Ross in Drew’s News. Butcher and author of “The Butcher Babe Cookbook” Loreal Gavin shares her special marinade revealing her secret ingredient.

st: Josh Groban, D-I-Y Kid Craft, Cooking with Farideh
d: Grammy-nominated musician Josh Groban chats. Drew is joined on Zoom by kids of her show staff and The Craft Studio founder to create a fun flower craft. Executive Culinary Director at VICE Media Farideh Sadeghin teaches Drew how to make a Frito Pie.

st: Halloween Celebration with Adam Sandler, Pumpkin Blaze, Jill Kargman
d: Drew kicks-off her week-long Halloween celebration with Netflix’s “Hubie Halloween” star Adam Sandler. Then, actress Jill Kargman and Drew visit Pumpkin Blaze Long Island! Plus, Drew tackles dating at any age in her signature “Love Bug” segment.

st: Kristen Wiig, Jamie Dornan, Annie Mumolo, Design Week with Nate Berkus
d: “Barb + Star Go To Vista Del Mar” stars Kristen Wiig, Jamie Dornan and Annie Mumolo chat. Design week starts with interior designing duo Nate Berkus and Jeremiah Brent. Interior designer Mikel Welch helps transform a bedroom being shared by two sisters.

st: Julianna Margulies, “Outer Banks” star Chase Stokes, Eitan Bernath Shares Favorite Summer Dish
d: Actress Julianna Margulies stops by to discuss her new memoir “Sunshine Girl: An Unexpected Life.” Then, “Outer Banks” star Chase Stokes joins Drew. Culinary contributor Eitan Bernath whips up his favorite summer dish a watermelon feta arugula salad.

st: Leah Remini, Beauty Tips with Patrick Starrr
d: Game Show week concludes with “People Puzzler” host Leah Remini. Then, Drew is talking all things beauty with beauty influencer Patrick Starrr. Plus, Drew and Ross Matthews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all-new “Drew’s News.”

st: Wildflower: Model Winnie Harlow, Mom’s Time Out
d: Drew spotlights women in signature "Wildflower." Laura Sobiech and Director Justin Baldoni discuss her son Zach’s battle with cancer inspiring a number one song. In "Mom’s Time Out," Drew surprises one deserving mom with an all-expenses paid vacation!

st: Comedian Gabriel Iglesias, "Friendsgiving" Cast
d: Host of Nickelodeon’s new animal talent show "Unleashed" comedian Gabriel Iglesias shares with Drew one of his favorite acts.  Cast of the new film "Friendsgiving" including Malin Akerman, Kat Dennings, Aisha Tyler and Chelsea Peretti stop by to chat.

st: Anne Hathaway, "The Daily Show’s” Dulce Sloan
d: Week-long Halloween celebration w/ "The Witches" star Anne Hathaway. "The Daily Show's" Dulce Sloan introduces some single men & their furry sidekicks! Drew goes down to the basement of the CBS Studios with ghosthunter Steve Gonsalves to hunt for ghosts!

st: Jessica Simpson, Drew Does…Line Dancing, Bearded Dragon Cooking with Chef Lenny
d: Jessica Simpson chats. Drew tries something new based on viewer requests in new segment “Drew Does…,” first up line dancing. Co-author of “Chef Lenny Cooking for Humans” bearded dragon Chef Lenny & his owner Valerie Musser whip up Ma’s Famous Carrot Cake.
